name_input: BBM Bommidala Group (Bommidala Enterprises Pvt. Ltd)
export_evidence: No export record retrieved. ImportKey pages for this entity show only INBOUND customs rows, e.g. "2026-02-18 CERDIA INTERNATIONAL GMBH BOMMIDALA ENTERPRISES PRIVATE LIMITED CERDIA FILTER TOW 2.4 Y 25000 HK (ACETATE TOW) ... Rotterdam, GERMANY HYDERABAD ICD INSNF6, India 55021090 7596259" — i.e. Bommidala is the Indian BUYER, not the shipper. ImportKey header states "Total Shipments 1070 Records detected" but only 5 dated rows were visible on the free page; all 5 are imports (HS 55021090, 48132000, 56012200). No outbound B/L with destination, date and HS 240110/240120 was found.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report supply split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403; volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge. DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable ("Connection refused") for all queries, so no domestic-supply page could be located.
note: Evidence gap, not a negative finding. The only shipment data actually seen is import-side: Bommidala Enterprises Pvt. Ltd (D.No.8.24.53, Mangalagiri Road, Guntur; also listed at Survey No.96, Kompally, Secunderabad - 500 014, Telangana) appears as consignee of acetate filter tow, cigarette paper and capsule filters from Cerdia International (Germany), PT Bukit Muria Jaya (Indonesia), Yumin Corporation (South Korea) and Hertz & Selck (Germany), latest visible row 2026-02-18. ImportKey's buyer/supplier tables list counterparties such as RAY TOBACCO INC (Hong Kong), NETWORK STAR LIMITED (Hong Kong), KAANE AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL (UAE) and INTERCONTINENTAL TOBACCO FZE (Ajman) alongside Bommidala, which is consistent with an export trade in tobacco but is NOT a shipment record with date/destination/B-L and is therefore not counted as confirmation. Declared HS 240110/240120 (unmanufactured tobacco) is not contradicted by anything seen, but no export line with that HS was observed. Industry claim "Строительство и DIY" (construction/DIY) is inconsistent with all observed cargo (tobacco-manufacturing inputs) — flag for correction, not a rejection ground. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy was found; per project rules the company is not rejected. Recommended next step: paid Volza/Eximpedia export view or DGFT/ICEGATE shipper search to establish whether outbound tobacco shipments exist.
